description:
Search products by name across one or all Irish supermarkets.

    Args:
        query: words to match in product names, case-insensitive
            (e.g. "heinz baked beans", "kerrygold butter", "pringles").
        store: optionally filter to one of "aldi", "tesco", "supervalu",
            "dunnes", "lidl". Leave it out to search all five.
        limit: how many results to return in total (default 10).

    Returns the matching product rows: store, SKU id, name, brand, price,
    unit_price (€/kg or €/L), pack_size, category_path, url. Matches on the
    name only: no ingredient, nutrition or offer filters, and no price sorting.
name: search_products

id.description: Stable per-retailer product id, e.g. tesco:12345
id.title: Id

name.description: Product name as the retailer lists it
name.title: Name

shelf_path.description: Where the retailer shelves it, every level, e.g. 'Fresh Food > Yoghurts > Kefir > Kefir Drinks'
shelf_path.title: Shelf Path

unit_basis.description: The unit unit_price is measured in
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: Price per kg or per litre
unit_price.title: Unit Price

title: Search Irish supermarket products
